page.overview:
Who is Chaotic Darkness?

The Chaotic Darkness is the final boss of Season One of Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. It is the cumulative evil of humanity's hearts that was slowly accumulated in the Crystals of the Land of the Crystals as a result of wars and conflict in the world of Lapis, which was given form by Sol as a Vision to use it as his weapon to destroy all life.

On its initial form the Chaotic Darkness resembles a massive foggy mass of darkness with a vaguely noticeable face. It looks like a giant skeletal monster consisting mostly of a large skull head and arms surrounded by blue flames.

Its second form is a deformed amalgamation of several monsters, including Sand Worm, Arachne, Intangir, White Dragon, Zu, Flan, Ariman, Architeuth, Mantises, while the skeletal first form is reduced to a small portion tied to a bulbous mass of flesh.

The Chaotic Darkness was born as a result of all the negative emotions of humanity accentuated through centuries of conflict. These negative feelings and memories began to accumulate on the Crystals for several years, shapeless but alive.
